description.en: This resource model provides the first level of the MAEASaM grid used for the remote sensing surveys undertaken by the project.

nodes.description: This indicates the number of maps that are associated with the relevant grid square
nodes.name: Number of maps

nodes.description: The licence under which the digital resource may be used or reused.
nodes.name: Licence

nodes.description: Another field that links to the MAEASaM ID of all relevant Site resource instances linked to the map associated with the grid square.
nodes.name: Related sites

nodes.description: The date on which this resource record was added to Arches.
nodes.name: Uploaded at

nodes.description: The value is the relevant Standarized Site Enumeration System (SASES) id for the relevant grid square. This is a required field
nodes.name: SASES ID

nodes.description: The recommended citation to use when referring to or reusing the resource.
nodes.name: Preferred Citation

nodes.description: The person or organisation holding or managing rights associated with the resource.
nodes.name: Rights holder

nodes.description: The name of the individual responsible for creating the resource record.
nodes.name: Recorder

nodes.description: A field that lists the MAEASaM ID of all the identified remote sensing sites located within the relevant square.
nodes.name: Related remote sensing sites

nodes.description: Additional information about rights, permissions, restrictions, or copyright status that is not captured by the other rights and access fields.
nodes.name: Rights Notes

nodes.description: The most recent date on which the resource record was modified.
nodes.name: Last modified at

nodes.description: Any additional information relevant to this resource that the recorder feels should be documented.
nodes.name: Comment

nodes.description: This value represents the name of the relevant grid and is based on the centroid of each grid square, with a precion of 3. This is a required field
nodes.name: Grid square long

nodes.description: This value is a controlled vocabulary that indicates the digitisation status of the map associated with the grid square. Please write the term exactly as recorded in the "Map status" controlled vocabulary.
nodes.name: Map status

nodes.description: A unique identifier assigned to each resource. Format: GRID-9-digit number (e.g. GRID-000016993).
nodes.name: MAEASaM ID

nodes.description: The geometry of the square is provided in WKT format. This is used for upload and display in Arches for each grid square entry. This is a required field
nodes.name: Geometry (WKT)

nodes.description: This field links to the MAEASaM ID of the relevant map/s. Please write the MAEASaM ID of the relevant record from the "Maps" resource instance.
nodes.name: Related maps

nodes.description: The date on which the resource record was created in the database.
nodes.name: Created at

nodes.description: Indicates the number of remote sensing sites that have been identified within the relevant grid square.
nodes.name: Number of remote sensing sites

nodes.description: This value indicates the number of sites that are present within the relevant grid square.
nodes.name: Number of sites

nodes.description: This field indicates the current status of the remote sensing survey located within the relevant grid square. Please write the term exactly as recorded in the "Remote sensing survey progress" controlled vocabulary.
nodes.name: Remote sensing survey progress status

nodes.description: The level of access permitted for the digital resource.
nodes.name: Access level

nodes.description: This value represents the name of the relevant grid and is based on the centroid of each grid square, with a precion of 1. This is a required field
nodes.name: Grid square short

nodes.description: The name of the individual that uploaded this resource record to Arches.
nodes.name: Uploader
